name: Convenient Love
source:
All's well at work, until a notorious troublemaker shows up. Your favorite regular is the target. You intervene, heart sinking and strangely hopeful. Could this be romance, or just trouble?

[From [url=https://hexid.itch.io/convenient-love]Itch.io[/url]]
